description: The pie chart presents the distribution of dialogue state tracking slot categories (i.e., different slot types) as proportions of the whole, shown as 14 slices with percentage annotations. The largest slice is an unlabeled green segment at approximately 19.0% (its text appears obscured), followed by “from” in medium blue at 17.00%, “to” in yellow at 14.50%, and “genre” in dark green at 13.50%. The remaining slices are smaller and labeled with callouts: “name” (dark blue) 5.20%, “size” (brown) 4.20%, “time” (light green) 4.10%, “intent” (light blue) 3.80%, “location” (yellow) 3.80%, “destination” (green) 3.00%, “city” (blue) 2.60%, “class” (gold) 2.40%, “range” (pale green) 2.20%, “type” (light blue) 2.00%, plus two very small top slices “beds” (pale yellow) 1.30% and “passengers” (dark) 1.10%. There is no separate legend; labels are placed inside the larger wedges and outside with leader lines for smaller wedges, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the wedges appear arranged roughly from larger segments on the right/bottom to smaller segments clustered near the top.
